theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_ccm_coprime_orbit_product
theorems.statement: ∀ (G X Y : Type) [Group G] [MulAction G X] [MulAction G Y] (g : G) (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero n], Nat.Coprime m n → (∀ x : X, (g ^ m) • x = x) → (∀ y : Y, (g ^ n) • y = y) → Nat.card (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (Subgroup.zpowers g) (X × Y))) = Nat.card (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (Subgroup.zpowers g) X)) * Nat.card (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (Subgroup.zpowers g) Y))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
